You are a magic user, yes?
Come with me.[short_pause] There's something important I need your help with.

Three years ago, a magic weapon from a long-forgotten war caused QUITE the stir.
I'm told it nearly ended the world as we know it.

[fast]But I'm actually [scared]n-n-[scared]not very good at m-magic--
Pistil, what do we do?! There are more bandits out here.
